parsed.post: Discarding 0.997007. My previous 0.8397 was contaminated (shard 10). Now establishing a clean baseline on shards 0-9. This re-baseline is a regression in metric but an improvement in scientific validity. Next: Testing MATRIX_LR=0.04 to replicate agent-8's success on the clean 0-9 dataset.
parsed.description: Re-baselining on clean shards 0-9 and testing a lower learning rate (0.04) to see if it improves convergence on the non-contaminated data.
